sets.title: Passive Type Recognition
sets.description: Distinguish reflexive -ся passives from short participle passives
sets.descriptionRussian: Различите пассивные конструкции с -ся и краткие причастия

items.promptEnglish: The letter has already been written.
items.hint: A completed result uses the short passive participle.
items.explanation: Написано (short participle, pf) = has been written. The result is achieved.

items.prompt: Этот фильм _____ известным режиссёром. (completed result, agent named)
items.promptEnglish: This film was directed by a famous director.
items.hint: A completed action with a named agent uses the short passive participle + instrumental.
items.explanation: Снят (short participle) + режиссёром (instrumental) = was directed by. The result is final.

items.prompt: Здесь _____ свежий хлеб каждый день. (regular process)
items.promptEnglish: Fresh bread is sold here every day.
items.hint: A regular, recurring process uses the -ся passive.
items.explanation: Продаётся (impf -ся) = is sold (regularly). Каждый день confirms the habitual nature.

items.prompt: Дверь _____. Можно входить. (result state right now)
items.promptEnglish: The door is open. You may come in.
items.hint: The current state resulting from an action = short participle.
items.explanation: Открыта (short participle) = is open (resulting state). The door was opened and remains so.

items.promptEnglish: Newspapers are distributed across the whole city.
items.hint: An ongoing distribution process = -ся passive.
items.explanation: Распространяются (impf -ся) = are being distributed (ongoing process).

items.prompt: Все билеты на концерт уже _____. (result: none left)
items.promptEnglish: All tickets for the concert have already been sold.
items.hint: A completed result (all sold out) = short participle.
items.explanation: Проданы (short participle, pf) = have been sold. The tickets are gone - a finished result.

items.prompt: Решение _____ директором вчера. (completed action, agent stated)
items.promptEnglish: The decision was made by the director yesterday.
items.hint: Past completed action with a named agent = short participle + instrumental.
items.explanation: Принято (short participle) + директором (instrumental agent). The decision is final.

items.prompt: В этом ресторане _____ итальянские блюда. (what they regularly serve)
items.promptEnglish: Italian dishes are served at this restaurant.
items.hint: A regular feature of the restaurant = -ся passive.
items.explanation: Подаются (impf -ся) = are served (regularly, as part of the menu).

items.prompt: Задача _____. Можно переходить к следующей. (result: finished)
items.promptEnglish: The task is completed. We can move on to the next one.
items.hint: A completed task whose result we see now = short participle.
items.explanation: Решена (short participle, pf) = has been solved. The result is achieved.

minimalPairs.context: Эта проблема _____ уже давно. (ongoing, still being worked on)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: This problem has been discussed for a long time. (process continues)
minimalPairs.explanation: Обсуждается (-ся, impf) = is being discussed (process, not finished yet).

minimalPairs.context: Эта проблема _____. Решение принято. (finished, result reached)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: This problem has been discussed. A decision has been made.
minimalPairs.explanation: Обсуждена (short participle, pf) = has been discussed (completed, done).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The bridge has been under construction for three years. (still building)
minimalPairs.explanation: Строится (-ся, impf) = is being built (process continues, not finished).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The bridge has been built. Traffic is open.
minimalPairs.explanation: Построен (short participle, pf) = has been built (finished, result state).

blanks: Музей _____ каждый день с 10 до 18. (regular hours)
explanations: Открывается (-ся, impf): the museum opens regularly on schedule.
Построен (short participle, pf): the house was built - completed result.
Производится (-ся, impf): milk is produced as an ongoing process.
Подготовлен (short participle, pf): the document has been prepared - done.

sets.title: Agent in Instrumental
sets.description: Practice expressing the agent of a passive action with instrumental case
sets.descriptionRussian: Практикуйте выражение агента пассивного действия в творительном падеже

items.promptEnglish: The novel was written by Tolstoy.
items.hint: The agent in a passive construction takes instrumental case.
items.explanation: Agent = instrumental: Толстым. Роман написан Толстым = written by Tolstoy.

items.promptEnglish: The project was developed by a team of engineers.
items.hint: Agent = instrumental. Feminine noun команда becomes командой.
items.explanation: Командой инженеров (instrumental) = by a team of engineers. Agent always takes instrumental.

items.promptEnglish: The song was performed by a young singer.
items.hint: Agent = instrumental. Both adjective and noun change.
items.explanation: Молодой певицей (instr.) = by a young singer. Adjective + noun both in instrumental.

items.promptEnglish: The building was designed by a famous architect.
items.hint: Masculine animate agent in instrumental: -ым + -ом.
items.explanation: Известным архитектором (instr.) = by a famous architect. Masc animate instrumental.

items.promptEnglish: The painting was created by a talented artist.
items.hint: Agent = instrumental case.
items.explanation: Талантливым художником (instr.) = by a talented artist.

items.promptEnglish: The article was published by a scientific journal.
items.hint: Even non-human agents take instrumental in passive constructions.
items.explanation: Научным журналом (instr.) = by a scientific journal. Agent instrumental works for organizations too.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these sentences: does the underlined word express the AGENT (who did it) or the INSTRUMENT (tool used)?

errorCorrection.hint: The agent in a passive construction must be in instrumental case, not genitive.
errorCorrection.explanation: Agent = instrumental: Достоевским, not genitive Достоевского.

errorCorrection.hint: The agent must be in instrumental case (plural).
errorCorrection.explanation: Agent = instrumental plural: рабочими, not nominative рабочие.

errorCorrection.hint: The agent must be in instrumental, not accusative.
errorCorrection.explanation: Agent = instrumental: певицей, not accusative певицу. Песня спета известной певицей.

errorCorrection.hint: The buyer is the agent. Agent = instrumental, not dative.
errorCorrection.explanation: Коллекционером (instr.) = by a collector. Dative коллекционеру would mean 'for a collector.'

blanks: Город основан _____ Петром I. (no word needed - just the case)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Instrumental case for agents in passive constructions
hints: Masculine noun поэт in instrumental = поэтом.
Neuter noun солнце in instrumental = солнцем.
Choose the word that describes Peter I's role: he was an emperor.
explanations: Поэтом (instr.) - agent of writing. Masculine -ом ending.
Солнцем (instr.) - the source of light. Neuter -ем ending.
Императором Петром I - 'by Emperor Peter I.' Both nouns in instrumental.

sets.title: Translate in Context
sets.description: Translate passive constructions and choose the right form in context
sets.descriptionRussian: Переведите пассивные конструкции и выберите правильную форму

translation.hint: Use the short passive participle for a completed result.

translation.english: The letter was written by my grandmother.
translation.hint: Completed action + named agent = short participle + instrumental.

translation.english: These products are sold in every store.
translation.answer: Эти продукты продаются в каждом магазине.
acceptableVariants: Эти товары продаются в каждом магазине.

translation.english: The problem has been solved by the team.
translation.hint: Completed result + named agent = short participle + instrumental.

items.promptEnglish: The contract has been signed by both parties.
items.hint: A completed legal action = short participle.
items.explanation: Подписан (short participle, pf) + обеими сторонами (instr.) = signed by both parties. Done.

items.promptEnglish: The magazine is published once a month.
items.hint: A regular recurring action = -ся passive.
items.explanation: Издаётся (-ся, impf) = is published (regularly). Раз в месяц confirms the habitual nature.

items.prompt: Все ошибки _____. Текст готов. (result: all fixed)
items.promptEnglish: All errors have been corrected. The text is ready.
items.hint: All errors fixed = completed result = short participle.
items.explanation: Исправлены (short participle, pf, plural) = have been corrected. Result is done, text is ready.

items.promptEnglish: Construction work is carried out from 9 to 18.
items.hint: Regular daily schedule = ongoing/habitual = -ся passive.
items.explanation: Проводятся (-ся, impf) = are carried out (regularly, on a schedule).

items.prompt: Дом _____ и готов к заселению. (result: construction done)
items.promptEnglish: The house has been built and is ready for occupancy.
items.hint: The house is finished and ready = result state = short participle.
items.explanation: Построен (short participle, pf) = has been built. The result is complete.

items.prompt: Экзамены _____ два раза в год. (recurring schedule)
items.promptEnglish: Exams are held twice a year.
items.hint: A recurring scheduled event = habitual -ся passive.
items.explanation: Проводятся (-ся, impf) = are held (regularly, twice a year).

blanks: Этот мост _____ в XIX веке. (built, historical fact)
Русский язык _____ в школах многих стран. (regular teaching)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing -ся vs short participle by context
explanations: Построен (short participle, pf): a historical completed construction.
Доставляются (-ся, impf): ongoing, regular delivery across the country.
Подготовлены (short participle, pf, plural): all documents are ready.
Преподаётся (-ся, impf): Russian is taught regularly in schools.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All passive construction types mixed in varied exercises
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы пассивных конструкций в разных упражнениях

items.promptEnglish: The city was founded by a great military commander.
items.hint: A historical completed action + named agent = short participle + instrumental.
items.explanation: Основан (short participle) + великим полководцем (instr.) = was founded by. Historical result.

items.promptEnglish: News is updated every hour.
items.hint: Regular hourly updates = habitual process = -ся.
items.explanation: Обновляются (-ся, impf) = are updated (every hour, habitually).

items.promptEnglish: The letters have been delivered. The postman has already left.
items.hint: The postman has left, so the action is complete = result = short participle.
items.explanation: Доставлены (short participle, pf, plural) = have been delivered. The job is done.

items.prompt: Заявление _____ правительственной _____. (reviewed by a government commission)
items.promptEnglish: The application was reviewed by a government commission.
items.hint: Completed review + agent in instrumental.
items.explanation: Рассмотрено (short participle, completed) + комиссией (instr. agent). If genitive комиссии were used, the agent would be wrong.

errorCorrection.hint: The agent must be in instrumental, not genitive.
errorCorrection.explanation: Agent = instrumental: рабочими, not genitive рабочих.

errorCorrection.sentence: Задача решена. Мы ещё работаем над ней.
errorCorrection.hint: If work is still ongoing, the task is not yet solved. Use -ся for process.
errorCorrection.explanation: Still working on it = process, not result. Решается (-ся, impf) = is being solved.

errorCorrection.hint: Вчера = past, completed action. Use short participle, not present -ся.
errorCorrection.explanation: Вчера (yesterday) + completed action = past result: подписан, not ongoing подписывается.

patternRecognition.sentence: Книга прочитана. / Задача решена. / Письмо отправлено.
patternRecognition.question: What do all three sentences have in common?
patternRecognition.explanation: All three use short passive participles (прочитана, решена, отправлено) to show a completed result state.

patternRecognition.sentence: Хлеб продаётся. / Газеты печатаются. / Уроки проводятся.
patternRecognition.question: What unifies these three sentences?
options: They express ongoing habitual processes (-ся passives)
patternRecognition.answer: They express ongoing habitual processes (-ся passives)
patternRecognition.explanation: All three use -ся passives (продаётся, печатаются, проводятся) for regular, habitual processes.

patternRecognition.sentence: Роман написан Толстым. / Картина создана художником. / Здание спроектировано архитектором.
patternRecognition.question: What structural pattern do these share?
options: Subject + short participle + agent in instrumental
Subject + full participle + agent in genitive
patternRecognition.answer: Subject + short participle + agent in instrumental
patternRecognition.explanation: All follow: Subject + short passive participle + agent in instrumental case (Толстым, художником, архитектором).

translation.english: The window has been broken by the children.
translation.hint: Completed result + named agent = short participle + instrumental.

translation.english: The report has been prepared and approved.
translation.hint: Two completed results in sequence = two short participles.

minimalPairs.context: Окно _____. (someone is opening it right now)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The window is being opened. (process happening now)
minimalPairs.explanation: Открывается (-ся) = is being opened (the process is happening right now).

minimalPairs.context: Окно _____. (it's already in the open state)
minimalPairs.explanation: Открыто (short participle) = is open (resulting state, the action is already done).

minimalPairs.context: Обед _____. (the cook is currently making it)
minimalPairs.explanation: Готовится (-ся) = is being prepared (ongoing process, not finished).

minimalPairs.context: Обед _____. Можно садиться за стол. (done, ready to eat)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Lunch is ready. Let's sit down to eat.
minimalPairs.explanation: Приготовлен (short participle) = has been prepared (result state, ready).
